prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Ghost ship Deck scene concept A, MIDDAY. Create one polished widescreen pixel-art game scene, matching the crisp readable hand-clustered 16-bit pixel-art quality of the FirstMate ship setting references already shown. Approximately 480x270 logical pixels enlarged cleanly, landscape 16:9. A single coherent spectral pirate galleon, strictly LEVEL SIDE-ON BROADSIDE, bow LEFT, raised stern RIGHT, horizontal deck and keel; no three-quarter angle. Rotted walnut-grey timber, softly glowing jade-green seams, two masts and tattered semi-transparent mint sails, frayed Jolly Roger. Pale sun behind mist in a real moody silver-grey midday sky, dithered gradients; layered deep teal sea with irregular wave shapes and broad parallax wave bands. Distant haunted coast with crooked tombstones, chapel ruin and ghost lighthouse. Clear playable deck with generous interior rail margins: working friendly ghost pirates at central capstan and ghost rigging; waiting skeleton helmsman by wheel on raised right stern; blocked lantern-eyed sailor at left bow beside spectral mermaid figurehead; sleepers visible in separate spacious portholes below deck. Show eight distinct friendly small pirate looks through different hats, coats and ghost/skeleton silhouettes. Narrow rope ladder vertically flat against main mast BEHIND the sails, climbing sailor visible beside sail edge, ghost lantern in crow's nest. Open hatch exhales green mist and one arriving ghost rises through it. Small ravens on yard, drifting will-o-wisps, a floating candle and faint underwater jellyfish. A clearly horizontal plank extends from LEFT bow beyond hull over empty water, separated from a cute half-submerged ghost anglerfish at bottom RIGHT; fish lure glows and tiny speech bubble contains only '…'. Evergreen spooky-fun, readable charming figures, no gore, pumpkins or Halloween dressing. Keep substantial sky above and water below. No UI labels, no title, no border, no photorealism, no smooth vector shapes. Establish the single design used for subsequent night/storm studies.

Edit the just-generated Ghost ship midday concept into a production-plausible PIXEL ART game scene. Preserve its coherent ship design, level broadside bow left/stern right, haunted silver mist coast, green seam glow and four crew stations. Make a disciplined coarser pixel grid and bold clean pixel clusters, like a 480x270 logical-pixel game screenshot enlarged 3x with nearest neighbor. Small sailors must read as 18-24-pixel sprites, not finely rendered illustrations. Reduce noisy microtexture, retain beautiful wave shapes, dithered sky, timber details and friendly character silhouettes. Zoom out enough to show BOTH complete mast tips, flag and crow's nest with a generous sky margin. CRITICAL correction: REMOVE the slanted ladder running in front of the left sail. The only climb ladder is a narrow perfectly vertical ladder touching the main mast, hidden BEHIND sail cloth, visible just below sail and above it; show climber in visible gap near nest. Keep a broad horizontal left plank visibly over water. Keep all figures safely inside rails except deliberate departure on plank. Keep eight varied ghost/skeleton/lantern-eyed pirate looks, separate visible sleeping hammocks through portholes, pale sun, jellyfish underwater. The right-hand anglerfish must be HALF UNDERWATER, body crossed at mid-height by waterline with dim teal lower half, glowing lure and exact three-dot '…' speech marker above. No text except that marker. No border, no UI, no perspective change. Landscape 16:9.

Use case: lighting-weather. Make the NIGHT SHOWPIECE version of this exact Ghost ship pixel-art concept. Preserve the same level side-on broadside galleon, bow left, stern right, hull silhouette, two masts, mermaid figurehead, left horizontal plank, central working capstan, right raised wheel, porthole sleeping berths, open mist hatch, eight distinct friendly pirate designs and right-half-submerged anglerfish. Keep the crisp clean 16-bit clustered pixel style, not painted realism. Deep indigo and desaturated violet dithered night sky, a large pale silver moon upper left with narrow moving-looking cloud wisps crossing its face. Fine stars distributed across the ENTIRE sky from left to right and top to horizon, including right side. Thicker layered low fog; strongly luminous jade-green lantern glass, seams, tattered translucent sails, jellyfish and far lighthouse. Crew are explicitly translucent ghosts and friendly skeleton ghosts: deck planks, ropes and background can be seen THROUGH their torsos, with bright eyes, hats and contours keeping each readable. Distinguish eight looks. Lanterns stay behind nearby people. Sails cover the central portion of the narrow vertical ladder flat against mast, ladder visible only through torn gaps and beyond cloth. Night bats in the sky, ravens on yard, faint will-o-wisps and floating candles spread across water. Retain irregular wave forms and underwater depth. Anglerfish at bottom right sits across the actual surface, lower half dim underwater, glowing lure and exact '…'. Entire ship and mast tips within frame. Spooky-fun, no gore or seasonal decoration, no labels, landscape 16:9.

Use case: lighting-weather. Ghost ship concept C: PEAK STORM. Reuse the exact galleon identity from the last image: level broadside, bow left/raised stern right, two masts, shredded jade sails, mermaid figurehead, central capstan and green seams, friendly ghost/skeleton crew, hatch, porthole hammocks, left horizontal departure plank. Render a dramatically intense midnight haunted sea storm in the same crisp chunky pixel-art game style, landscape 16:9. Pull camera back to fit the COMPLETE ship, all mast tips, sky margin and water action. Entire pane has layered heavy violet-grey fog and slanting rain from TOP EDGE to bottom, dark high overcast, ONE branching green lightning bolt in the sky. Dramatic irregular rolling waves and sea spray, sails billowing and frayed flags whipped sideways, glowing timbers and lanterns. Large spectral translucent ghost WHALE breaches in background water to the LEFT of the ship with an unmistakable whale head, flippers and curved tail, bright jade-white outline and water cascading off it; its lower body meets real waves. A SECOND distant spectral sailing SHIP passes through background fog on the RIGHT, much smaller and faint, distinct from hero vessel and whale. In foreground LEFT under projecting plank: a large skeletal KRAKEN rising out of a luminous green whirlpool, friendly-spooky skull-like cephalopod head and long vertebra-like bony tentacles wrapping around one tiny departing ghost pirate, no gore. Kraken is partially submerged, lower limbs occluded by swirling opaque water and green mist; whirlpool is clearly in open water beyond hull. Anglerfish suggestion creature stays small and half-submerged at bottom RIGHT, clear of kraken, glowing lure with '…'. Keep all main deck stations legible amid storm, strong dark/light hierarchy, no labels or border, no photorealism, no pumpkins. This is the quality and intensity target for busy-fleet peak.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a Ghost ship departure animation concept storyboard, four equally sized panels in a clean 2x2 grid, same fixed side-on camera in EVERY panel, crisp richly detailed clustered pixel-art game art matching the last ghost galleon image. This is a CLOSE-UP of the LEFT bow only: rotted green-seam timber and spectral mermaid figurehead on the RIGHT of each panel, wide wooden plank extending HORIZONTALLY LEFT from deck over OPEN WATER, never lying across hull, never vertical. Show enough deck to see approach to plank. Friendly translucent pirate wearing tricorne and green coat, 1/5 the eater's height. Navy teal layered sea, violet mist, green whirlpool directly BELOW free plank end, isolated from suggestion fish (no anglerfish in this close-up). Four successive cinematic poses: top-left, pirate visibly walks to end of long horizontal plank, only small rotating green water spiral below; top-right, pirate drops feet-first from plank into whirlpool and mist splash, huge skeletal cephalopod skull breaks the WATER SURFACE below; bottom-left, skeletal KRAKEN rears with green-lit hollow skull and six long segmented bone tentacles, wraps pirate safely in curled tentacle, open mouth clearly swallowing the small ghost, lower tentacles obscured by opaque rotating waves; bottom-right, pirate gone and kraken fully sunk with only a fading green ring/ripple and wispy mist, NO stranded tentacle, no tail sticking up. Convey a 2-second rise/wrap/swallow/sink moment after visible plank walk. Each waterline visibly crosses creature, dark submerged sections below, never a creature pasted on top of water. Same boat/plank geometry across all panels. Comic spooky-fun, absolutely no gore or violence detail. No labels, no timing text, no headings, no arrows. Landscape wide sheet. Each panel should be a buildable animation pose reference, not a different monster.

Use case: stylized-concept. Ghost ship concept E, close-up of its friendly GHOSTLY ANGLERFISH suggestion creature. Use the attached night galleon as a design reference ONLY for its small bottom-right fish, colour palette and crisp clustered pixel-art style. One large fish in profile facing left, whimsical spectral teal anglerfish, round lantern eyes, jagged cartoon teeth and translucent fins, curved long angler stalk with a bright jade-green glowing lure above its head. The sea surface crosses the fish EXACTLY through middle of its body horizontally: upper head, eye and top back above water, lower jaw, belly and lower fins clearly UNDER water, visible dimly through deep blue-green translucent water. Add an irregular real wave crest overlapping the front of the fish across that split and traveling concentric green/teal surface ripples, never fish hovering above ocean. Deep underwater jellyfish and suspended motes softly glowing below the split; violet mist and dark haunted coast hinted in background above. Precise three-dot ellipsis '…' in a small white PIXEL speech balloon above the lure. Comfortable clear target silhouette, distinct from skeletal kraken, spooky-friendly rather than threatening. Clean coarse 16-bit pixel clusters enlarged nearest-neighbor, beautiful dark navy/teal/jade restrained palette; no photorealism, no smooth vector. Landscape 3:2 close-up, no labels or other text, no border, no full ship.

Use case: stylized-concept. Ghost ship concept F: one extremely wide HAUNTED-ISLAND VOYAGE panorama, 3:1 aspect ratio, designed as a horizontally looping parallax phase-strip for a side-on pixel-art game. Match the palette and pixel craftsmanship of the reference night ghost ship scene, but NO foreground hero ship and NO crew, NO UI. Strict level horizon; one coherent misty archipelago stretches across the whole width. Arrange five readable distinct landmarks in this left-to-right journey: GRAVEYARD ISLE with crooked tombstones and dead cypress; a big SKULL-SHAPED ROCK with eroded eye holes; a RUINED GOTHIC CHAPEL with broken rose window and luminous green windows; SHIP GRAVEYARD with several broken wooden hulls, crooked masts and hanging rigging; a GHOST-LIT LIGHTHOUSE on jagged rocks with an emerald lantern and a narrow pale-green beam. Separate landmarks by sea/fog channels so they read at game scale. Farther low islands behind, ragged black rock silhouettes, violet-grey parallax fog weaving through them, dark teal sea with layered irregular wave shapes. Moonless navy-violet dithered sky with small stars across ENTIRE width; no large moon that would duplicate every repeat. Green lights embedded in the buildings and ghost lamps attached to the coast so everything travels together. Small raven silhouettes belong on chapel stones; no whale or life fixed over scrolling coast. LEFT and RIGHT edges must both end in the SAME empty mist and water at SAME heights and colours, no cut-off landmark: design edge transitions for a seamless approximately 20-minute loop. High craft clean blocky 16-bit pixel art, not fine painterly noise; landscape panorama 3:1; no writing, headings, labels, frames or border. Tone spooky-fun, no gore, no pumpkins.

Edit this 2x2 Ghost ship plank-departure storyboard with ONLY these targeted animation corrections. Preserve pixel-art style, all boat/plank geometry, side-on camera, four panels and palette. TOP LEFT: remove the kraken head peeking in the whirlpool; sea is at rest with just a subtle small green swirl as pirate walks visibly on horizontal plank. TOP RIGHT: keep drop and surfacing kraken. BOTTOM LEFT: make the swallowing unmistakable, the friendly tiny ghost pirate held in a bony tentacle directly at the large kraken's open central mouth, lower half of pirate already disappearing behind the mouth/tentacle; no gore. BOTTOM RIGHT: remove ALL kraken anatomy completely, especially the little skull and eyes currently poking from the whirlpool. Pirate and kraken are now FULLY submerged and invisible; ONLY a calm fading green ripple ring, ordinary waves and a wisp of mist remain. This final clean empty-water rest pose is essential. Do not add any eyes, tentacles, head or tail in that final panel. Keep no labels or text.

Make ONE precise edit to this ghostly anglerfish pixel-art close-up. Inside the small white speech balloon above the lure, REPLACE the three black plus/cross/star shapes with THREE SIMPLE SOLID BLACK SQUARE DOTS, equally spaced horizontally on one baseline. Exact text meaning: ellipsis, '...'. Each dot is just a filled square of pixels, no arms, no crosses. Preserve every other part of the image exactly: fish anatomy and eye, split waterline through body, glowing lure, waves, green reflections, background, palette, crop and all pixel art. Do not change the speech balloon outline or position. No additional text.
